supersedes.reason: The bounded remediation re-review confirmed prior F1 and F2 mechanically closed but found changed-surface F3: the newly emitted purpose field still accepted arbitrary canonical identifiers and could reproduce a plaintext secret-scope identifier in diagnostics. This second-round follow-up preserves all earlier evidence and closes the root cause with one closed versioned purpose vocabulary enforced independently at the port and structured logger.

checks.result: The exact final remediation commit passed all ten credential and strict portable-contract tests in 1.377 seconds, with one expected directory-symlink privilege skip. The production default-sink test now proves scope-like and secret-like strings cannot construct SecretAccessContext and are independently redacted by the structured logger, while each of the four governed purpose codes remains attributable.

All six frozen Windows sidecar tests passed in 20.976 seconds, with one expected governed-file symlink privilege skip. The packaged runtime imports and runs the closed SecretPurpose port and Windows adapter without system Python.

All 111 governed source files pass format, lint, and configured typing; patch hygiene passes; and the exact remediation commit is clean. Quality report SHA-256: 0f09c0908a67b299545311efb5b2516bc14f304e8b0cfac5b44c302916e0ab16. Before freezing the identical source bytes, the 62-test incremental credential/contract/Core/envelope/ADR/build union and architecture/package-smoke checks also passed.

evidence: SecretAccessContext and SecretAuditEvent now require the closed SecretPurpose enum: provider-authentication, connector-authentication, signing-verification, or object-encryption. A profile, subject, name, arbitrary canonical identifier, or canonical-looking secret cannot be reclassified as purpose.

The structured logger separately accepts only those four governed strings for its purpose field and redacts every other value. The default production audit therefore remains attributable without creating a plaintext identifier/value injection channel. Prior bounded filesystem recovery, ciphertext retention, DPAPI, CAS, restart, and leakage guarantees remain unchanged.

The default-sink regression submits local-default, provider-example, primary-api-key, and canonical-looking-secret as hostile purposes. Port construction raises ValueError and the lower-level structured logger emits [REDACTED] for each, while the valid provider-authentication put/lease records retain the exact approved projection.

The strict portable profile test requires the exact ordered four-code vocabulary and rejects replacement with free-form. Exact credential, contract, package, quality, and prior incremental integration checks pass.

The portable profile/schema now version the exact purposeCodes set. ADR-0017, architecture, and contract README state that arbitrary canonical identifiers cannot be promoted to audit purposes; implementation, diagnostics, and documentation agree.
No other audit fields, secret kinds, storage behavior, dependency, migration, UI, provider integration, later S04 duty, or unrelated capability surface changed.
